title: Rockstar JB “Get Me A Bag” feat Gucci Mane
htmlContent:
https://youtu.be/AfTbAvUrnI8 While Rockstar JB is steadily establishing himself within his Cali home turf over the past two-years with a relentless amount of live public performances (alongside the likes of Gucci Mane, The Game, Juicy J, DJ Mustard, YG, Nipsey Hussle) the release (7-7-17) of his debut album, LSD, certainly sounds like a young artist on the lift. LSD boasts an impeccable line up of some of the games most notable players, including Juicy J, Wiz Khalifa, AKTHESAVIOR of The Underachievers and Gucci Mane, who appears on the albums debut single "Get Me A Bag" (grown by Larry Jay).

Purchase Rockstar JB’s LSD at iTunes & Amazon:

iTunes: https://itunes.apple.com/album/id12528

Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B073HMRF7P
